nodes.label: start
nodes.speaker: Nera
nodes.text: Please tell me you are the rescue party.

nodes.label: roan
nodes.speaker: Roan
nodes.text: We are a party. The rescue part is new.

nodes.label: yuufa
nodes.speaker: Yuufa
nodes.text: Then we should start before the cart notices.

nodes.label: driver_first
nodes.speaker: Nera
nodes.text: The driver. And a parcel with a blue cord. Driver first. Please.

nodes.label: rescued
nodes.speaker: Driver
nodes.text: I thought you would take the parcel and leave.

nodes.label: louder
nodes.speaker: Yuufa
nodes.text: You were considerably louder than the parcel.

nodes.label: reports
nodes.speaker: Nera
nodes.text: It contains missing-person reports. Someone has been collecting the originals.

nodes.label: start
nodes.speaker: Hald
nodes.text: Your first job fixes your career in normal play. You can promote and be reborn within that path, but cannot change to another.

nodes.label: limits
nodes.speaker: Yuufa
nodes.text: And discover which limits are yours to change.

nodes.label: consent
nodes.speaker: Player
options: I understand. This is my path.

nodes.label: more_time
nodes.speaker: Hald
nodes.text: Good. A considered answer is cheaper than a lifelong mistake.

nodes.label: vanguard
nodes.speaker: Roan
nodes.text: Then I will trust you to choose where we stand.

nodes.label: pathfinder
nodes.speaker: Roan
nodes.text: Then show me what I cannot see from behind a shield.

nodes.label: keeper
nodes.speaker: Roan
nodes.text: Then I will listen when you tell me we cannot keep pushing.

nodes.label: commission
nodes.speaker: Hald
nodes.text: The reports lead to Payon. You are not commissioned to solve a kingdom's problems. You are commissioned to deliver a parcel.

nodes.label: names
nodes.speaker: Nera
nodes.text: And perhaps ask why every copy has a different name.

nodes.label: start
nodes.speaker: Roan
nodes.text: Do you think a real adventurer knows when they have started?

nodes.label: bill
nodes.speaker: Yuufa
nodes.text: Usually when the bill arrives.

nodes.label: answer
nodes.speaker: Player
options: We started when we went back for the driver.

nodes.label: rule
nodes.speaker: Roan
nodes.text: Then let us make one rule. If someone falls behind, we notice.

nodes.label: inconvenient
nodes.speaker: Yuufa
nodes.text: And if noticing is inconvenient?

nodes.label: return
nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We go back.

nodes.label: offer
nodes.speaker: Yuufa
nodes.text: Then would you like us to travel with you? Roan can hold a road. I can help keep you both on it.

nodes.label: consent
nodes.speaker: Player
options: Come with me. We go together.
I need a little more time.

nodes.label: later
nodes.speaker: Roan
nodes.text: We will be here. No one gets left behind because they needed a moment.

nodes.label: welcome
nodes.speaker: Yuufa
nodes.text: Then it is settled. Try not to make our first rule necessary before lunch.

nodes.label: start
nodes.speaker: Judia
nodes.text: That marker said something else yesterday.

nodes.label: weather
nodes.speaker: Nera
nodes.text: Weather can take paint off wood. It cannot rewrite the receipt in my pocket.

nodes.label: daughter
nodes.speaker: Judia
nodes.text: His daughter does. Today. That is why I would prefer we hurry. She is safe with her family; this is not a race against a clock.

nodes.label: vanguard
nodes.speaker: Judia
nodes.text: You keep the search road open. I will follow the tracks.

nodes.label: pathfinder
nodes.speaker: Judia
nodes.text: Two sets of eyes. Let us see which one the liar forgot.

nodes.label: keeper
nodes.speaker: Judia
nodes.text: Stay with the family while we work. Tell them what we know, not what we hope.

nodes.label: directions
nodes.speaker: Nera
nodes.text: A young man in southern Payon remembers his grandfather. Monster Scholar Vuicokk, on the northern road, studies the cave's dead. Ask him about Undead Monsters.

nodes.label: rubbing
nodes.speaker: Judia
nodes.text: Hear both accounts. Then compare the old burial register at the cave entrance. A name is easier to steal when only one copy remains.

nodes.label: evidence
nodes.speaker: Nera
nodes.text: The family remembers Henrik. The altered receipt says Henrich. The old record agrees with the family. Same dates. Same house. Different name.

nodes.label: distinction
nodes.speaker: Judia
nodes.text: The dead here already have enough trouble resting. This change was made by someone living.

nodes.label: alberta
nodes.speaker: Nera
nodes.text: The paper carries an Alberta warehouse seal. I will bring these accounts to the family. Meet Maya at the warehouse; she knows the shipping ledgers.

nodes.label: start
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: Relief supplies do not generally need armed guards facing inward.

nodes.label: veyr
nodes.speaker: Veyr
nodes.text: The guards protect the records from theft. Their contents are irreplaceable.

nodes.label: people
nodes.speaker: Veyr
nodes.text: Of course. Records are how we find people when the world loses them.

nodes.label: driver
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: Then your invoices should help us find the missing driver.

nodes.label: permission
nodes.speaker: Veyr
nodes.text: You may examine them. I would rather have suspicious helpers than incurious ones.

nodes.label: instructions
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: The open dispatch ledger is beside the warehouse entrance. Compare its destination and date with the blue-cord receipt. We keep our copy; no one needs to steal the book.

nodes.label: route
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: Alberta to Geffen. Ink, medicine, and a second list of names that never appears on the freight manifest.

nodes.label: help
nodes.speaker: Veyr
nodes.text: Then I shall have the duplicate sent to the Geffen relief office. Ask for the clerk who keeps the older files. They deserve care too.

nodes.label: thanks
nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank you. We will compare both copies.

nodes.label: inn
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: And before we collect another bill, come to the inn. We should decide who is paying which share.

nodes.label: start
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: If we keep sharing expenses, I require a name for the ledger.

nodes.label: heroic
nodes.speaker: Roan
nodes.text: Something heroic.

nodes.label: short
nodes.speaker: Judia
nodes.text: Something short enough to shout while running.

nodes.label: recognize
nodes.speaker: Yuufa
nodes.text: Something the missing might recognize when we come looking.

nodes.label: name_choice
nodes.speaker: Player
options: Let us give it a name.

nodes.label: later
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: The ledger can wait. The bill has shown considerably less patience.

nodes.label: named
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: {GUILD}. Good. Now it exists in two ledgers and one exceptionally untidy heart.

nodes.label: principle
nodes.speaker: Player
options: We make room for people who need us.

nodes.label: staying
nodes.speaker: Judia
nodes.text: Then I am staying. Someone should make sure you notice the tracks.

nodes.label: maya
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: And someone should make sure your heroic organization survives its first grocery bill. May we travel with you?

nodes.label: consent
nodes.speaker: Player
options: Welcome to the guild, both of you.
Let me settle a few things first.

nodes.label: welcome
nodes.speaker: Yuufa
nodes.text: A guild with a promise, a name, and an accountant. We may be dangerously close to respectable.

nodes.label: next
nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: Geffen is next. Its relief office has the older records. We follow the shipment, not every rumour in the kingdom.
